# Part I: live concurrency evidence, generated by `make simulate-concurrency` on 2026-10-30 against the Integration Service (current code, port 8102), Fineract 1.15.0 (IDE instance, same database as the container) and the Mock ERP container. PARALLEL=12 threads, real HTTP.

==== I1 sequential duplicates
  initial state: loan LN-2026-000012 Approved, Fineract disbursements=0
  request: POST /api/loans/LN-2026-000012/disburse external_reference=LN-2026-000012-DISB x4 (sequential)
  responses: {200: 4}
  fineract state: disbursements=1 ids=[27]
  erp state: journal entries for LN-2026-000012-DISB: 1 (entry_id=29)
  integration state: transactions for LN-2026-000012-DISB: 1 state=COMPLETED
  expected: requests 4, Fineract disbursements 1, ERP journal entries 1, integration transactions 1
  actual: requests 4, Fineract disbursements 1, ERP entries 1, integration transactions 1
.
==== I2a concurrent disbursements, same reference
  initial state: loan LN-2026-000013 Approved, no disbursement
  request: 12 simultaneous POST .../disburse external_reference=LN-2026-000013-DISB
  responses: first wave {200: 1, 202: 11}, after settling 202s {200: 12}
  fineract state: disbursements=1
  erp state: entries for LN-2026-000013-DISB: 1
  integration state: transactions for LN-2026-000013-DISB: 1 state=COMPLETED
  expected: exactly one Fineract disbursement, one ERP entry, one integration transaction
  actual: 1 / 1 / 1
.
==== I2b concurrent disbursements, different references
  initial state: loan LN-2026-000014 Approved, no disbursement
  request: 12 simultaneous POST .../disburse with references LN-2026-000014-DISB-00..LN-2026-000014-DISB-11
  responses: {200: 1, 409: 11}; 409s refused by: {'db_index': 11, 'fineract': 0}
  fineract state: disbursements=1
  erp state: entries: 1 ['LN-2026-000014-DISB-01']
  integration state: COMPLETED=['LN-2026-000014-DISB-01'], other rows={}
  expected: exactly one disbursement in Fineract, one ERP entry, one COMPLETED transaction; the rest 409
  actual: 1 / 1 / 1; 11 x 409
.
==== I3 concurrent repayments, different references + duplicates of one
  initial state: loan LN-2026-000015 Active, Fineract totalOutstanding=5500799.0
  request: 10 simultaneous repayments (LN-2026-000015-R00..LN-2026-000015-R09, amounts 100000..109000) + 3 duplicates of LN-2026-000015-R00
  responses: first wave {200: 3, 202: 3, 503: 7}; settling pass re-executed 7 (the rest were replays)
  fineract state: repayments=10, sum of recorded amounts=1045000.0, totalOutstanding=4455799.0
  erp state: entries: 10
  integration state: {'LN-2026-000015-R00': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R01': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R02': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R03': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R04': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R05': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R06': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R07': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R08': 'COMPLETED', 'LN-2026-000015-R09': 'COMPLETED'}
  expected: each reference applied once: 10 Fineract repayments; final = initial - sum(Fineract amounts) = 4455799.0
  actual: 10 repayments; final 4455799.0
.
